title: Working the Engels
executive_producers: Katie FordJane FordHoward BusgangTom NursallNoreen Halpern
premise_summary: Working the Engels is a Canadian-American sitcom that premiered on Global on March 12, 2014, and was also a part of NBC's summer schedule, having premiered on July 10, 2014. Produced by Halfire-CORE Entertainment, it marked the first time that U.S. and Canadian broadcasters had collaborated in producing a half-hour network sitcom.
